title: scandix stellata subsp. velutina
intro: Scandix stellata subsp. velutina, commonly known as Velvet Shepherd's Needle, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful for reducing oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Velvet Shepherd's Needle include its ability to stimulate digestion, alleviate flatulence, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it useful for gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include coumarins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
